# account service

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:accountService`](gmeow-accountService.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/accountService>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/accounts`](../../slices/accounts.md)
